Name: Gift Money
Author: AvalonMFX
Description:
This mod adds the ability to gift money to NPCs. The mod comes with a customisable config. The money required will automatically scale with your progress. Feel free to disable that feature though.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/g0PPXKI.png[/img]

You have to be close to an NPC (approximately the range required to talk to it). After that, press the [b]F5[/b] button (can be changed in config). A UI will appear where you can select the type of gift. When hovering over it, the price will appear.
 

[u][img]https://i.imgur.com/McdxEAD.png[/img][/u]

The amount required scales with the game's progress. However, you can disable it and add your own limits. Those are the default values:

[list]
[*][b]Loved Gift:[/b] 10k
[*][b]Liked Gift:[/b] 7.5k
[*][b]Neutral Gift:[/b] 5k
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xNpNelE.png[/img]﻿﻿

[color=#6aa84f][b]Compatible with:[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][b][color=#6aa84f][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/color][/b]
[*]Multiplayer
[*]Modded NPCs
[/list]

[/b]
